product_metadata.title: 20 Pieces Non Slip Bathtub Stickers Non Slip Shower Sticker Adhesive Decals with Bright Colors, Daisy Bath Tread and Anti-Slip Appliques for Bathtub and Other Slippery Surfaces
features: Non slip stickers: the surface of the sticker has approximately 1180 tiny protrusions on each piece, which can prevent dangerous slips and falls in bathroom effectively

More stickers and less slips: 20 pieces of non slip adhesive stickers, covering more of your bathtub's surface than a typical bath mat does, offering a wider non-slip surface; Ample quantity can be applied in 2 or 3 bathrooms
Durable material: made from durable and good quality plastic for lasting use, bath stickers can adhere to most smooth and non-porous surfaces including glass, tile, fiberglass and some metals
Enjoy happy bath time: non slip stickers are designed according to the shape of the flowers; They are colorful, beautiful and elegant, which will bring more fun to your bathing experience

Simple and convenient installation: just peel off the backing paper and stick on the smooth surface, which costs just a few minutes; Attention: please clean the surface before installation by removing lipid and dirt
